_comment: Short lines the app itself says or shows, per target language. Spoken lines are read by the tutor's voice. nativeInputNote is prepended to the learner's text in the user turn when they switched to their native language ({{native}} and {{target}} are filled in). correctionMarkers = phrases that mean the tutor is correcting (ReplyCheck drops such a sentence mid-chat). common = prompt fragments shared by every language. wordLabOpening = what Word lab says first when the model's opening didn't name the word the app picked (the deterministic fallback; {{word}} is filled in).

es.tookTooLong: Perdona, tardé demasiado. Vamos otra vez.
es.paused: Pausa. Toca el micrófono cuando quieras seguir.
es.nativeInputNote: (The learner said this in {{native}}. Answer in {{target}}, and say the {{target}} words they needed.)
es.endOfChat: Gracias por la charla. ¡Hasta la próxima!
es.wordLabOpening: La primera palabra es «{{word}}». ¿Sabes lo que significa?

en.didNotCatch: I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
en.tookTooLong: Sorry, that took me too long. Let's try again.
en.paused: Paused. Tap the microphone when you want to go on.
en.nativeInputNote: (The learner said this in {{native}}. Answer in {{target}}, and say the {{target}} words they needed.)
en.endOfChat: Thanks for the chat. See you next time!
en.wordLabOpening: The first word is “{{word}}”. Do you know what it means?

fr.didNotCatch: Je n'ai pas bien entendu. Tu peux répéter ?
fr.tookTooLong: Pardon, j'ai mis trop de temps. On recommence.
fr.paused: Pause. Touche le micro quand tu veux continuer.
fr.nativeInputNote: (The learner said this in {{native}}. Answer in {{target}}, and say the {{target}} words they needed.)
fr.endOfChat: Merci pour la conversation. À la prochaine !
fr.wordLabOpening: Le premier mot est « {{word}} ». Tu sais ce qu'il veut dire ?

pt.tookTooLong: Desculpa, demorei demais. Vamos outra vez.
pt.paused: Pausa. Toca no microfone quando quiseres continuar.
pt.nativeInputNote: (The learner said this in {{native}}. Answer in {{target}}, and say the {{target}} words they needed.)
pt.endOfChat: Obrigado pela conversa. Até à próxima!
pt.wordLabOpening: A primeira palavra é «{{word}}». Sabes o que significa?

common._comment: Lines the app adds to a MODEL prompt (any language is fine for the model). retryLanguageNote is appended once when a reply came back in the wrong language.
common.retryLanguageNote: (Answer only in {{target}}, in at most {{maxSentences}} short sentences, as {{personaName}}.)
